GeoNames, CC BY 4.0; physical feature code definitions retained. Bounded candidate selection, not an exhaustive world inventory.

DBpedia and Wikipedia contributors, legacy data under CC BY-SA 3.0. Cross-language link counts are a knowledge-base familiarity signal, not measured answer popularity or a player survey. Missing facts remain unknown.
sources.limitation: Only captured positive predicates establish membership. Source records without a requested property are not evidence that an answer is factually invalid.

sources.attribution: HGNC, HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee, RRID:SCR_002827, CC0. Approved human protein-coding loci, names and former symbols; no nonhuman homologues.
sources.limitation: DNA features that can be tested by sequencing, not a claim that every gene has a dedicated approved clinical test.

sources.attribution: MusicBrainz / MetaBrainz Foundation and contributors, core names and identifiers under CC0. Supplementary tags, annotations, descriptions and search scores excluded.
sources.limitation: Bounded 500-result core-name capture; includes instrument families and ensembles, for the broad music-making prompt.

sources.query:
# Bounded legacy CC BY-SA DBpedia candidate capture.
SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?name WHERE { ?item a <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/BoardGame>; <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label> ?name. FILTER(LANG(?name)="en") } LIMIT 10000
sources.attribution: DBpedia and English Wikipedia contributors, legacy Wikipedia-derived data under CC BY-SA 3.0; source pages and their author histories retained per record. Labels and disambiguation metadata transformed. This does not use the Fusion KG.
sources.limitation: Bounded capture of the public legacy endpoint. Capture date is not a claim that every source article was updated that day.
